source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 2 (PDF 36-50), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 2 (Bacteria and Viruses) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 The five-kingdom classification system was proposed by:
(Five-kingdom classification system kis ne pesh kiya?)
blocks.explanation: Five-kingdom system Robert H. Whittaker ne pesh kiya (2.1).

book_ref.quote: the five-kingdom classification system, proposed by Robert H. Whittaker

blocks.prompt:
2 In the five-kingdom system, all prokaryotes are placed in the kingdom:
(Five-kingdom system mein tamam prokaryotes kis kingdom mein hain?)
blocks.explanation: Tamam prokaryotes alag kingdom Monera mein hain; baqi chaar kingdoms eukaryotes ki hain (2.1).

book_ref.quote: all prokaryotes are included in a separate kingdom i.e., the kingdom Monera

blocks.prompt:
3 Because molecular studies highlighted flaws in the five-kingdom system, most biologists favour:
(Molecular studies se five-kingdom system ki khamiyan saamne aane par zyada tar biologists kis ko pasand karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Zyada tar biologists is ki jagah three-domain system chahte hain jo molecular data se zyada milta hai (2.1).

book_ref.quote: most biologists favour replacing it with a new system, called three-domain system

blocks.prompt:
4 All bacteria have a unicellular prokaryotic organization that lacks:
(Tamam bacteria ki unicellular prokaryotic banawat mein kya nahi hota?)

options.text: membrane wale organelles, aur wazeh nucleus

blocks.explanation: Bacteria mein membrane wale organelles, aur wazeh nucleus, nahi hote; in ki cellular banawat sab se saada hai (2.1).

book_ref.quote: which lack membrane bounded organelles, including a well-defined nucleus

blocks.prompt:
5 The major component of the bacterial cell wall is:
(Bacterial cell wall ka asal juz kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bacterial cell wall ka asal juz aik munfarid macromolecule peptidoglycan ya murein hai (2.1).

book_ref.quote: called peptidoglycan or murein

blocks.prompt:
6 The technique of Gram's staining was devised by:
(Gram's staining ka tareeqa kis ne banaya?)
blocks.explanation: Sir Hans Christian Gram ne Gram's staining ka tareeqa banaya (2.1).

book_ref.quote: Sir Hans Christian Gram devised the technique of Gram’s staining

blocks.prompt:
7 Gram-positive bacteria stain purple because they:
(Gram-positive bacteria purple kyun nazar aate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Gram-positive bacteria violet dye rok lete hain aur purple nazar aate hain; Gram-negative dye nahi rokte aur asli rang mein dikhte hain (2.1).

book_ref.quote: Gram-positive bacteria stain purple because they retain violet dye

blocks.prompt:
8 The cell wall of Gram-positive bacteria has:
(Gram-positive bacteria ki cell wall mein kya hota hai?)

options.text: patli peptidoglycan tah aur outer membrane
moti peptidoglycan tah aur kam lipid

blocks.explanation: Gram-positive wall mein moti peptidoglycan tah aur kam lipid hota hai; Gram-negative mein patli tah aur outer membrane (2.1).

book_ref.quote: The cell wall of Gram-positive bacteria contains thick layer of peptidoglycan and has less lipid content

blocks.prompt:
9 Porin is a protein of the Gram-negative outer membrane that:
(Porin Gram-negative ki outer membrane ka protein hai jo:)

options.text: khaas molecules ke liye surakh ka kaam karta hai

blocks.explanation: Gram-negative ki outer membrane ka porin khaas molecules ke liye surakh ka kaam karta hai (2.1).

book_ref.quote: It contains a protein called porin, which acts like a pore for specific molecules

blocks.prompt:
10 Gram-negative bacteria are resistant to many antibiotics because of their:
(Gram-negative bacteria bohat si antibiotics ke khilaf mazahmat kyun rakhte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Lipopolysaccharides aur lipoproteins ki outer membrane Gram-negative ko bohat si antibiotics se bachati hai (2.1).

book_ref.quote: The outer membrane makes Gram-negative bacteria resistant to many antibiotics

blocks.prompt:
11 The periplasmic space is the space between:
(Periplasmic space kis ke darmiyan ki jagah hai?)
blocks.explanation: Periplasmic space peptidoglycan tah aur cell membrane ke darmiyan hai; Gram-negative mein yeh zyada hai (2.1).

book_ref.quote: space between peptidoglycan layer and cell membrane

blocks.prompt:
12 The capsule produced by some bacteria outside the cell wall is a:
(Kuch bacteria cell wall ke bahar jo capsule banate hain woh kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Capsule cell wall ke bahar jelly jaisi tah hai jo colonies ko chipchipa banati hai (2.1).

book_ref.quote: It is a gelatinous layer and gives sticky characters to bacterial colonies

blocks.prompt:
13 The bacterial cell membrane differs from that of eukaryotes in that it lacks:
(Bacterial cell membrane eukaryotes se is tarah mukhtalif hai ke is mein kya nahi hota?)
blocks.explanation: Bacterial cell membrane ki banawat mein sterols (maslan cholesterol) nahi hote (2.1).

book_ref.quote: The cell membrane of bacteria does not have sterols

blocks.prompt:
14 In bacteria that lack a cell wall, the outermost layer is the:
(Jin bacteria mein cell wall nahi hoti un mein sab se bahar kaun si tah hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jin bacteria mein cell wall nahi, yani mycoplasmas aur spiroplasmas, un mein cell membrane sab se bahar hai (2.1).

book_ref.quote: It lies at the outermost in bacteria that lack cell wall

blocks.prompt:
15 Mesosomes are formed by:
(Mesosomes kaise bante hain?)

options.text: cell wall ke bahar murne se
cell membrane ke cytoplasm mein andar murne se

blocks.explanation: Kuch jagahon par cell membrane andar ki taraf mur kar vesicles, tubules ya lamellae banati hai: yeh mesosomes hain (2.1).

book_ref.quote: At some points, cell membrane invaginates and forms vesicles, tubules or lamellae in cytoplasm

blocks.prompt:
16 Bacterial cytoplasm lacks:
(Bacterial cytoplasm mein kya nahi hota?)
blocks.explanation: Cytoplasm mein nucleoid, ribosomes aur mesosomes hain magar cytoskeleton aur membrane wale organelles nahi (2.1).

book_ref.quote: It lacks cytoskeleton and membrane-bounded organelles

blocks.prompt:
17 Bacterial ribosomes sediment at:
(Bacterial ribosomes kis par sediment hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Har bacterial ribosome 70S hai, 50S aur 30S subunits se bana (2.1).

book_ref.quote: Each ribosome sediments at 70S

blocks.prompt:
18 The smaller subunit of a bacterial ribosome sediments at:
(Bacterial ribosome ki chhoti subunit kitne S par hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bari subunit 50S aur chhoti subunit 30S hai (2.1).

book_ref.quote: larger subunit at 50S and smaller subunit at 30S

blocks.prompt:
19 The irregular-shaped dense area near the centre of the bacterial cytoplasm that contains DNA is the:
(Bacterial cytoplasm ke beech ke qareeb be-tarteeb ghana hissa jis mein DNA ho, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nucleoid cytoplasm ke beech ke qareeb be-tarteeb ghana hissa hai jis mein DNA hota hai (2.1).

book_ref.quote: Near the centre of cytoplasm, there is an irregular-shaped dense area i.e., nucleoid

blocks.prompt:
20 Bacterial DNA differs from eukaryotic chromosomal DNA in that it:
(Bacterial DNA eukaryotic DNA se kaise mukhtalif hai?)

options.text: is ke saath histones nahi hote

blocks.explanation: Bacterial DNA aik, gol (circular) aur double stranded hai, aur is ke saath histones nahi hote (2.1).

book_ref.quote: Bacterial DNA does not have attached histones

blocks.prompt:
21 Plasmids are:
(Plasmids kya hain?)

options.text: khud copy banane wala chromosome se bahar ka gol DNA

blocks.explanation: Plasmids gol, double-stranded, chromosome se bahar ke DNA hain jo khud apni copy banate hain (2.1).

book_ref.quote: They are self-replicating and can replicate before or after division

blocks.prompt:
22 In genetic engineering, plasmids are used as:
(Genetic engineering mein plasmids kis tarah istemal hote hain?)

options.text: chuni genes bacteria tak le jane wale vectors

blocks.explanation: Plasmids vectors ke tor par chuni hui genes bacteria tak le jate hain, cloning ya khaas proteins banane ke liye (2.1).

book_ref.quote: They are used to carry selected genes to bacteria for cloning

blocks.prompt:
23 Endospores are:
(Endospores kaise hote hain?)

options.text: patli wall wale aur taqseem hote
moti wall wale aur metabolically ghair-faal

blocks.explanation: Endospores khaas aaram karne wale cells hain jo moti wall wale aur metabolically ghair-faal (dormant) hain (2.2).

book_ref.quote: Endospores are thick-walled and metabolically inactive

blocks.prompt:
24 The first step of sporulation, when a bacterium faces unfavourable conditions, is:
(Na-munasib halaat mein sporulation ka pehla qadam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Na-munasib halaat mein bacterium sab se pehle apna DNA replicate karta hai (2.2).

book_ref.quote: When a bacterium faces unfavourable conditions, it replicates its DNA

blocks.prompt:
25 During sporulation, the new DNA and a small portion of cytoplasm are isolated by a:
(Sporulation mein naya DNA aur thora cytoplasm kis cheez se alag kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cell membrane septum (parda) bana kar naye DNA aur thore cytoplasm ko alag karti hai (2.2).

book_ref.quote: Cell membrane makes a septum to isolate the new DNA and a small portion of cytoplasm

blocks.prompt:
26 In a developing endospore, the new DNA is surrounded by:
(Bante hue endospore mein naya DNA kis se ghira hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cell membrane dobara naye DNA, cytoplasm aur septum ke gird barhti hai, is liye naya DNA do membranes se ghira hota hai (2.2).

book_ref.quote: In this way, the new DNA is surrounded by two membranes

blocks.prompt:
27 During sporulation, a new peptidoglycan layer forms:
(Sporulation mein nayi peptidoglycan tah kahan banti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nayi peptidoglycan tah alag DNA aur cytoplasm ke gird do membranes ke darmiyan banti hai; phir is ke gird spore coat banta hai (2.2).

book_ref.quote: A new peptidoglycan layer forms between the membranes around separated DNA and cytoplasm

blocks.prompt:
28 During sporulation, what happens to the DNA of the vegetative cell?
(Sporulation mein vegetative cell ke DNA ka kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Vegetative cell ka DNA toot jata hai aur poora cell paani khone lagta hai (2.2).

book_ref.quote: The DNA of vegetative cell disintegrates and whole cell begins to dehydrate

blocks.prompt:
29 Under favourable conditions, an endospore:
(Munasib halaat mein endospore kya karta hai?)

options.text: germinate ho kar naya vegetative cell banata hai
kayi spores mein batt jata hai
doosre endospore se mil jata hai

blocks.explanation: Endospore munasib halaat tak dormant rehta hai, phir germinate ho kar naya vegetative cell banata hai (2.2).

book_ref.quote: Under favourable conditions, endospore germinates to give rise to a new vegetative cell

blocks.prompt:
30 Most bacilli and spirilla bacteria move by means of:
(Zyada tar bacilli aur spirilla bacteria kis ke zariye harkat karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Zyada tar bacilli aur spirilla flagella se tairte hain (2.3).

book_ref.quote: Most bacilli and spirilla bacteria move by means of flagella

blocks.prompt:
31 When a whole bacterial population moves together by means of flagella, the movement is called:
(Jab bacteria ki poori abadi flagella se aik saath harkat kare to ise kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Bacteria ki abadi ka flagella se mil kar chalna swarming kehlata hai (2.3).

book_ref.quote: When a bacterial population moves together by means of flagella, the movement is called swarming

blocks.prompt:
32 The cell is pushed forward with the flagellum trailing behind when the flagellum rotates:
(Flagellum ke kis taraf ghoomne se cell aage dhakela jata hai aur flagellum peeche rehta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Flagellum ke counter clockwise (ghari ki sooiyon ke ulat) ghoomne se cell aage jata hai (2.3).

book_ref.quote: Counter clockwise rotation of flagellum pushes the cell forward

blocks.prompt:
33 In gliding movement, bacteria move smoothly over solid surfaces by:
(Gliding mein bacteria sakht satah par asani se kaise phisalte hain?)

options.text: taqseem hote cells ke dhakke se

blocks.explanation: Gliding mein bacteria chipchipa maadda nikalte hain jo sakht satah par phisalne mein madad karta hai (2.3).

book_ref.quote: In gliding, bacteria secrete slimy substance

blocks.prompt:
34 Sliding movement in bacteria is due to:
(Bacteria mein sliding movement kis wajah se hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sliding taqseem hote cells ke dhakke se paida phailao ki wajah se hai (2.3).

book_ref.quote: It is due to the expansion created by the pushing force of dividing cells

blocks.prompt:
35 Streptococcus, which has no flagella or pili, moves by:
(Streptococcus, jis mein flagella ya pili nahi, kaise harkat karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Streptococcus jaise bacteria jin mein flagella ya pili nahi, Brownian movement se hilte hain, yani maye ke zarraat ki be-tarteeb harkat se (2.3).

book_ref.quote: Some bacteria (e.g., Streptococcus) that do not have flagella or pili

blocks.prompt:
36 The axial filament of spirochaetes runs length-wise in the:
(Spirochaetes ka axial filament lambai mein kahan chalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Axial filament, badla hua flagellum, cell membrane aur outer membrane ke darmiyan periplasmic space mein lambai mein chalta hai (2.3).

book_ref.quote: It is anchored at one end and runs length-wise in periplasmic space

blocks.prompt:
37 Bacteria that do not possess flagella are called:
(Jin bacteria mein flagella nahi hote unhein kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Flagella ke baghair bacteria atrichous kehlate hain (2.5).

book_ref.quote: The bacteria which do not possess flagella are called atrichous

blocks.prompt:
38 A bacterium with a single polar flagellum is:
(Aik qutbi (polar) flagellum wala bacterium kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aik polar flagellum wale bacteria monotrichous hain (2.5).

book_ref.quote: The bacteria with single polar flagellum are called monotrichous

blocks.prompt:
39 Bacteria with a tuft of flagella at one pole are called:
(Jin bacteria ke aik qutb par flagella ka guchha ho unhein kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aik qutb par flagella ka guchha lophotrichous; dono qutbon par flagella amphitrichous (2.5).

book_ref.quote: The bacteria with a tuft of flagella at one pole are called lophotrichous

blocks.prompt:
40 Amphitrichous bacteria have:
(Amphitrichous bacteria mein flagella kaise hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Amphitrichous bacteria ke dono qutbon par flagella hote hain (2.5).

book_ref.quote: The bacteria with flagella at each of two poles are called amphitrichous

blocks.prompt:
41 Bacteria with flagella surrounding the whole cell are:
(Jin bacteria ke poore cell ke gird flagella hon woh kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Poore cell ke gird flagella: peritrichous (2.5).

book_ref.quote: The bacteria with flagella surrounding the whole cell are called peritrichous

blocks.prompt:
42 Bacterial flagella are composed of:
(Bacterial flagella kis cheez se bane hain?)
blocks.explanation: Bacterial flagella eukaryotes ki tarah 9+2 microtubules par nahi bane; yeh flagellin protein se bane hain (2.5).

book_ref.quote: They are not built on 9+2 pattern of microtubules, but are composed of flagellin protein

blocks.prompt:
43 The three parts of a bacterial flagellum are:
(Bacterial flagellum ke teen hisse kaun se hain?)
blocks.explanation: Bacterial flagellum basal body, hook aur filament par mushtamil hai (2.5).

book_ref.quote: The bacterial flagellum consists of a basal body, a hook and a filament

blocks.prompt:
44 The basal body of the flagellum of a Gram-negative bacterium has:
(Gram-negative bacterium ke flagellum ki basal body mein kitne rings hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Basal body mein ghoomne wale rings hain: Gram-positive mein aik jora, Gram-negative mein do jore (2.5).

book_ref.quote: one pair in Gram-positive bacteria and two pairs in Gram-negative bacteria

blocks.prompt:
45 The part of a bacterial flagellum that connects the basal body with the filament is the:
(Bacterial flagellum ka kaun sa hissa basal body ko filament se jorta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hook aik mura hua hissa hai jo basal body ko filament se jorta hai (2.5).

book_ref.quote: The hook is a curved structure that connects basal body with the filament

blocks.prompt:
46 Pili are involved in attachment to surfaces and in:
(Pili satah se chipakne ke ilawa kis amal mein shamil hain?)
blocks.explanation: Pili chipakne ke liye aur cells ke darmiyan conjugation (milaap) mein istemal hote hain (2.5).

book_ref.quote: They are also involved in the mating process (conjugation) between cells

blocks.prompt:
47 The fossil record shows that prokaryotes were abundant:
(Fossil record ke mutabiq prokaryotes kab kasrat se thay?)
blocks.explanation: Fossils batate hain ke prokaryotes (archaea aur bacteria) 3.5 billion saal pehle kasrat se thay (2.6).

book_ref.quote: were abundant 3.5 billion years ago

blocks.prompt:
48 After appearing, prokaryotes remained all alone on Earth for the next:
(Paida hone ke baad prokaryotes kitne arse tak zameen par akele rahe?)
blocks.explanation: Prokaryotes agle 2 billion saal tak zameen par akele rahe (2.6).

book_ref.quote: They evolved and remained all alone on Earth for the next 2 billion years

blocks.prompt:
49 Margulis and Schwartz classified all prokaryotes into:
(Margulis aur Schwartz ne tamam prokaryotes ko kitne phyla mein taqseem kiya?)
blocks.explanation: Margulis aur Schwartz ne prokaryotes ko 16 phyla mein taqseem kiya (2.6).

book_ref.quote: They classified them into 16 phyla

blocks.prompt:
50 Rigid, rod-shaped, heterotrophic, Gram-negative bacteria that include Escherichia coli and vibrios are:
(Sakht, rod jaise, heterotrophic, Gram-negative bacteria jin mein Escherichia coli aur vibrios shamil hain:)
blocks.explanation: Omnibacteria sakht, rod numa, heterotrophic, Gram-negative hain; E. coli misaal hai aur vibrios bhi shamil (2.6).

book_ref.quote: These are rigid, rod-shaped, heterotrophic, Gram-negative bacteria

blocks.prompt:
51 Which statement about omnibacteria is correct?
(Omnibacteria ke baare mein kaun sa bayan sahi hai?)

options.text: yeh spores nahi banate aur aam tor par aerobic hain
in ki growth dhaage numa hai

blocks.explanation: Omnibacteria zyada tar flagella wale hain, spores nahi banate aur aam tor par aerobic hain (2.6).

book_ref.quote: They do not produce spores

blocks.prompt:
52 Cyanobacteria fix atmospheric nitrogen in special cells called:
(Cyanobacteria hawa ki nitrogen kin khaas cells mein fix karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Bohat se cyanobacteria hawa ki nitrogen heterocysts naam ke khaas cells mein fix karte hain (2.6).

book_ref.quote: Many cyanobacteria fix atmospheric nitrogen in their special cells called heterocysts

blocks.prompt:
53 Besides chlorophyll-a, cyanobacteria contain accessory pigments such as:
(Chlorophyll-a ke ilawa cyanobacteria mein kaun se madadgar pigments hain?)

options.text: carotenoids aur neele aur laal phycobilins

blocks.explanation: Cyanobacteria mein chlorophyll-a aur carotenoids aur neele aur laal phycobilins jaise pigments hain (2.6).

book_ref.quote: They contain chlorophyll-a and accessory pigments like carotenoids, and blue and red phycobilins

blocks.prompt:
54 In the history of the Earth, cyanobacteria played the most important role in:
(Zameen ki tareekh mein cyanobacteria ka sab se ahem kirdar kya tha?)

options.text: ozone khatam karne wali gasen banana
sulphur ko chatanon mein fix karna

blocks.explanation: Cyanobacteria ne fiza mein azad oxygen barhane mein sab se ahem kirdar ada kiya (2.6).

book_ref.quote: They played most important role in the history of the Earth for increasing free oxygen in atmosphere

blocks.prompt:
55 According to a recent discovery, the bulk of modern petroleum deposits were formed by masses of decayed:
(Haal ki daryaft ke mutabiq aaj ke petroleum zakheere zyada tar kin ke gale sare dheron se bane?)
blocks.explanation: Aaj ke petroleum ke zyada tar zakheere gale sare cyanobacteria se bane (2.6).

book_ref.quote: the bulk of our modern petroleum deposits were formed by masses of decayed cyanobacteria

blocks.prompt:
56 The colours of blooms in polluted water result from:
(Ganday paani mein blooms ke rang kis wajah se hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Rangeen blooms cyanobacteria ki tez growth se bante hain; rang in ke photosynthetic pigments ke hain (2.6).

book_ref.quote: Colourful blooms may occur in polluted water as a result of the rampant growth of cyanobacteria

blocks.prompt:
57 Mycoplasmas are resistant to penicillin because they:
(Mycoplasmas penicillin ke khilaf mazahmat kyun rakhte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Cell wall na hone se mycoplasmas aur spiroplasmas penicillin aur cell wall rokne wali antibiotics se bache rehte hain (2.6).

book_ref.quote: they are resistant to penicillin and other antibiotics that work by inhibiting cell wall growth

blocks.prompt:
58 The lethal yellowing disease of coconuts is caused by:
(Nariyal ki lethal yellowing bimari kis se hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Spiroplasmas paudon ki ahem bimariyan karte hain jaise nariyal ki lethal yellowing (2.6).

book_ref.quote: Spiroplasmas cause significant plant diseases e.g., the lethal yellowing disease of coconuts

blocks.prompt:
59 Spirochaetes are long spirilla with Gram-negative walls and may have:
(Spirochaetes lambe spirilla hain jin ki Gram-negative wall hai, aur in mein kitne flagella ho sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Spirochaetes mein 2 se 100 se zyada flagella ho sakte hain; Treponema ahem misaal hai (2.6).

book_ref.quote: They may have 2 to more than 100 flagella

blocks.prompt:
60 Syphilis is caused by:
(Syphilis kis se hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Treponema, aik ahem spirochaete, syphilis ka sabab hai (2.6).

book_ref.quote: Treponema are important spirochaetes

blocks.prompt:
61 Pseudomonas aeruginosa is usually harmless but can form serious infections in:
(Pseudomonas aeruginosa aam tor par be-zarar hai magar kin mein sangeen infection kar sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pseudomonas aeruginosa mitti, paani aur kachi sabziyon mein hota hai; aam tor par be-zarar, kamzor logon mein sangeen infection kar sakta hai (2.6).

book_ref.quote: Pseudomonas aeruginosa occurs in soil, water and raw vegetables

blocks.prompt:
62 Straight or curved Gram-negative rods with one or many flagella at one end, some of which take part in denitrification, are:
(Seedhe ya mure Gram-negative rods jin ke aik sire par aik ya kayi flagella hon aur kuch denitrification karen:)
blocks.explanation: Pseudomonads seedhe ya mure Gram-negative rods hain jin ke aik sire par flagella; kuch denitrification karte hain (2.6).

book_ref.quote: These are straight or curved Gram-negative rods with one or many flagella at one end

blocks.prompt:
63 Bacteria with filamentous growth forms and resistant spores are:
(Dhaage numa growth aur mazboot spores wale bacteria kaun se hain?)
blocks.explanation: Actinomycetes ki growth dhaage numa hai aur yeh na-munasib halaat ke khilaf mazboot spores banate hain (2.6).

book_ref.quote: These have filamentous growth forms

blocks.prompt:
64 Leprosy is caused by:
(Leprosy (kodh) kis se hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mycobacterium leprae, aik actinomycete, leprosy karta hai; Mycobacterium tuberculosis TB karta hai (2.6).

book_ref.quote: A member of this group i.e., Mycobacterium leprae causes leprosy

blocks.prompt:
65 Some actinomycetes are responsible for:
(Kuch actinomycetes kis ke zimmedar hain?)

options.text: dental plaque, jis mein daanton ka enamel tabah hota hai

blocks.explanation: Kuch actinomycetes dental plaque karte hain jis mein daanton ka enamel tabah hota hai (2.6).

book_ref.quote: Some actinomycetes are responsible for dental plaque

blocks.prompt:
66 About how many new antibiotics from actinomycetes are discovered each year?
(Actinomycetes se har saal taqreeban kitni nayi antibiotics daryaft hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Har saal actinomycetes se taqreeban 150 nayi antibiotics daryaft ho rahi hain (2.6).

book_ref.quote: About 150 new antibiotics from actinomycetes are being discovered each year

blocks.prompt:
67 Nitrogen-fixing actinomycetes are found in:
(Nitrogen fix karne wale actinomycetes kahan paye jate hain?)

options.text: bohat se phooldar plants ki root nodules

blocks.explanation: Kuch actinomycetes nitrogen fixers hain aur bohat se phooldar plants ki root nodules mein milte hain (2.6).

book_ref.quote: Some actinomycetes are nitrogen fixers and are found in the root nodules of many flowering plants

blocks.prompt:
68 Azotobacter, found in soil and water, belongs to which group?
(Mitti aur paani mein milne wala Azotobacter kis group se hai?)
blocks.explanation: Azotobacter nitrogen-fixing aerobic bacterium hai; yeh hawa ki nitrogen ko ammonia mein fix karta hai (book correction) (2.6).

book_ref.quote: Azotobacter is a member of this group

blocks.prompt:
69 Azotobacter fixes atmospheric nitrogen into:
(Azotobacter hawa ki nitrogen ko kis mein fix karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Azotobacter hawa ki nitrogen ko ammonia mein fix karta hai; phir nitrifying bacteria ammonia ko nitrite aur nitrate banate hain (2.6).

book_ref.quote: Azotobacter fixes atmospheric nitrogen into ammonia

blocks.prompt:
70 Chemosynthetic bacteria derive energy from:
(Chemosynthetic bacteria energy kahan se lete hain?)

options.text: nitrogen, sulphur aur iron ke inorganic compounds ki oxidation
murda organic maadde ko hazam karna

blocks.explanation: Chemosynthetic bacteria nitrogen, sulphur aur iron ke inorganic compounds ko oxidize kar ke energy lete aur khana banate hain (2.6).

book_ref.quote: These bacteria derive energy from the oxidation of inorganic compounds of nitrogen, sulphur and iron

blocks.prompt:
71 Nitrosomonas and Nitrobacter are:
(Nitrosomonas aur Nitrobacter kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nitrosomonas aur Nitrobacter chemosynthetic hain; yeh NH₃ ko oxidize karte hain aur yeh nitrite aur nitrate banti hai (2.6).

book_ref.quote: Nitrosomonas and Nitrobacter are included in this group

blocks.prompt:
